---
description: "Use when editing repository docs and README. Keep docs aligned with actual zsh behavior, flags, and startup policies."
applyTo: "README.md"
---

## Documentation accuracy
- Document only behavior that exists in the current code.
- Keep command examples aligned with current flags and aliases.
- Mention startup safety defaults when describing automation.

## Scope boundaries
- Do not document deprecated ~/.files/.zsh runtime patterns as required.
- Keep migration notes explicit when behavior changes.
